measurement.bullet_stepping: game advance_world; exact mechanical/world substeps per external 120 Hz tick
measurement.distance: sum of 3D chassis position differences, including slope motion
measurement.aerodynamic_work: end world-substep power sampled each 120 Hz tick; quadrature diagnostic
measurement.rolling_heat: sum of actual wheel-port dissipation over all mechanical substeps
measurement.input: VehicleCommand, direct pedals and center rack degrees; direction=D

rolling_initialization: after setting chassis initial velocity, call vehicle.tires.initialize_rolling(speed) once; no runtime realignment

sampling.state_fields: asdict(snapshot), recursively flattened; wheel pose fields expanded separately

commands.static_load: zero speed, zero controls; settle 2 s, observe 2 s
commands.flat_coast: 100 km/h initial; zero controls for 6 s; actuator input selects neutral gear
commands.flat_braking: 100 km/h initial; flat road, brake=1 until stopped or 6 s
commands.uphill_braking: 100 km/h initial tangent to +5 degree plane; brake=1 until stopped or 6 s
commands.downhill_braking: 100 km/h initial tangent to -5 degree plane; brake=1 until stopped or 6 s
commands.steering_step: 40 km/h initial; coast 0.5 s; center rack request=2 deg, throttle=0.15 for 3 s
commands.corner_braking: 40 km/h initial; rack request=2 deg, throttle=0.15 for 1.5 s; rack=2 deg, brake=0.7 for 2 s
commands.split_mu_braking: 100 km/h initial; brake=1 until stopped or 10 s; x<0 asphalt, x>=0 grass
commands.circle_20m: 20 km/h target; requested wheel angle=atan(wheelbase/20 m); 12 s
commands.circle_40m: 20 km/h target; requested wheel angle=atan(wheelbase/40 m); 12 s
commands.circle_60m: 20 km/h target; requested wheel angle=atan(wheelbase/60 m); 12 s

report_definition: 11 original completed cases plus split_mu_braking extended until stop; first 720 split ticks byte-identical. Environment plane descriptor corrected from horizontal to per-case; original reports preserved.

design_derivations.coast_derivation: m_eff=m+(4*Iw+(Jout+Jrear)*final_drive^2)/r^2; dv/dt=-(R+b*v^2)/m_eff, neutral, planar steady support approximation
